title: Cold Beer. Small Plates. Good Nights.
hero_alt: A crowd cheering under string lights at the Red Hot Cod bar, DJ decks in the foreground
body: Our new bar concept lands this summer, right next door to the original shop: a beer garden and bar built around small plates, cold beer and Balinese-inspired bites, with the same ocean-view energy as the takeaway shop next door.
Opening hours, the drinks list and the small-plates menu are still being finalised — follow along on Instagram for the announcement.

highlights.title: Beer Garden
highlights.body: Cold beer on tap, outdoors, with an ocean view.

highlights.title: Small Plates
highlights.body: Shareable bites built around the same wild-caught seafood.

highlights.title: Balinese-Inspired Bites
highlights.body: The same street-food flavours as the takeaway menu, bar-sized.

note: Opening hours and the bar menu will be announced closer to launch — follow @redhotcodburleigh for updates.
